data.heading: 1. Rabi Season harvest and Summer Season Sowing Status:
data.text:
-  As on May 22, 2026, the area sown under summer crops is 86.02 lakh ha as compared to 83.50 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.  Of this, area of 31.05 lakh ha has been sown under Rice this year. There is also an increase in the area sown under Maize by about 1.50 lakh ha so far from the last 5-years average.
-  As on 22.05.2026, 97.92% of area  has  been  harvested  for  Rabi  crops  all  over  India.  The  harvest  of pulses,  oilseeds,  and  Shri  Anna-cum-coarse  cereals  has  been  completed;  79.71%  area  of  Rice  and 99.50% area of Wheat has been harvested for Rabi crops 2025-26.

data.heading: Week 1 (22 May - 28 May 2026):
data.text:
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over many parts of Northwest India till 28th May and gradual fall by 3-5°C on 29th & 30th May.
-  Gradual  rise  in  maximum  temperatures  by  2-3°C  likely  over  Punjab  till  26th  May;  no  significant change on 27th & 28th May and gradual fall by 3-5°C on 29th & 30thMay.
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over Central India till 28th May and gradual fall by 2-4°C on 29th & 30th May.

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over East India till 26th May and gradual fall by 2-3°C during 27th - 30th May.
-  No significant change in maximum temperatures likely over the rest parts of country till 30th May 2026.

data.heading: Week 2 (29 May - 04 June 2026):
data.text:
-  Low  to  moderate  probability  of  Heatwave  conditions  likely  over  some  parts  of  northwest  India (Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, southern parts of Himachal Pradesh & Uttarakhand) during some/many days of the week.
-  Above  normal  (+1.6 to +3.0°C) to appreciably above normal (+3.1  to  +5.0°C)  maximum temperatures are likely over some parts of northwest India, and over some parts of northeast India. Below-normal  maximum  temperatures  (-1.6  to  -  3.0°C)  are  likely  across  some  parts  of  South Peninsular India,  and  near-normal  maximum temperatures  are  likely  across  the  rest  of  the  country during the week.
-  Low probability of warm night conditions is likely over Punjab, Haryana, and adjoining West Uttar Pradesh on some days of the week.

data.heading: Rabi Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Rice : About 31.05 lakh ha area coverage under Summer Rice has been reported as compared to 32.42 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Pulses : About 27.91 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 27.26 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Oilseeds : About 11.04 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 9.58 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
